description.value: Eva Bene Butterfly Garden is a community-run green space in Tsawwassen, BC, dedicated since 2003 to protecting and increasing local populations of butterflies, beneficial insects, and hummingbirds. It is a grassroots initiative with a public-access designation and an active Facebook community of around 185 followers. For touring cyclists, it offers a quiet natural stop in the Tsawwassen area.

raw_osm.description: Gardening to protect and increase the local population of butterflies, beneficial insects and hummingbirds
raw_osm.name: Eva Bene Butterfly Garden

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The OSM record identifies this as a community butterfly garden in Tsawwassen established in 2003, with access=yes confirming public access. The Facebook page corroborates the garden's name and mission description exactly, and shows activity as recently as March 31, 2024, confirming the garden is still active. Neither the OSM tags nor the Facebook content mention any cyclist amenities (bike parking, washrooms, water, etc.), so all amenity fields must be null.
concerns: No physical address available in OSM or on Facebook page, making precise location difficult to verify.
Only online presence is a Facebook page; no dedicated website for deeper amenity verification.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A real, publicly accessible community garden with confirmed recent activity (March 2024); a legitimate scenic stop for touring cyclists in the Tsawwassen area.

wow_evidence: Community-run butterfly and pollinator garden since 2003; community-garden ladder. Note: located in Tsawwassen, community field says White Rock — geocode mismatch.
blurb: Community butterfly garden in Tsawwassen, planted for pollinators since 2003.
